name: io.github.Voidborn-Industries/mindupload
title: Mind Upload AI meta harness
description: Your AI mind directs coding agents; work reviewed against your memories: Claude Code, Codex, Cursor

tools.name: consult_mind
tools.description: Ask the owner's Mind Upload consciousness, an AI built from the owner's own memories, values and way of thinking, how they would approach this task. Call it before any task that will change files or run a commit, push, release, deploy, migration or deletion, and again when a consequential decision changes the plan. It can add what the owner stored in Mind Upload and your instructions do not hold: their priorities, the tradeoffs they accept, past mistakes and what “done” means to them. Put the goal, constraints, options and your proposed approach in one question; it cannot read your files, so share screenshots, recordings or audio as evidence files (evidence_files, or share_evidence and then evidence_ids). On success it returns decision, a reply in that consciousness's own words and in the language of the question, and consciousness, naming who answered, plus the analysis status of each evidence file or media link. The reply is advice, not permission. Skip it only for questions that change nothing.

question.description: The goal, constraints, options and proposed approach, and the decision that needs the owner's judgment.

task_id.description: Stable identifier for the whole task. Reuse it across consult_mind and review_work so later calls include earlier exchanges.

decision_id.description: New for each distinct question; reuse the same value only to retry an identical call.

media_evidence.description: Optional HTTPS links the user authorized to screenshots, audio or video of the result. Not with evidence files in one call. The reply's media_analysis says whether each link was analyzed, refused or failed.

evidence_ids.description: Ids from share_evidence whose files you uploaded; the consciousness reads their analysis. Not with media_evidence or learn.

learn.description: True only when the owner wants their mind to learn from this exchange. Needs the owner's learning permission; what it learns waits for the owner's review unless they auto-keep. Not with evidence files.

clone_id.description: Only when the owner approved several consciousnesses: the clone_id the owner chose.

tools.name: review_work
tools.description: Before you tell the user that a task which changed files, or ran a commit, push, release, deploy, migration or deletion, is done, call review_work with the original request, the diff excerpts and the test output you observed; if review_work is unavailable or fails, say plainly that no Mind Upload review ran. It asks the owner's Mind Upload consciousness to review the work against the original request, the evidence you supply, and the rules and past mistakes it remembers. Supply the original request, the actual result or diff excerpts, and the verification output you observed; it cannot read files or run tests, so a claim that tests passed is not evidence. Share screenshots, recordings or audio of the result as evidence files (evidence_files, or share_evidence and then evidence_ids), not inside the evidence text. user_request, work and evidence share one size limit with the review instructions the connector adds: about 6,400 characters together after JSON escaping, less with media links. An oversized call is refused before anything is sent. On success it returns review, findings by severity in the language of the user request, naming what it finds missing or wrong, and consciousness, naming who answered, plus the analysis status of each evidence file or media link. That reply is an opinion, not approval: investigate each finding, fix what is real, and review the changed work under a new review_id. Call it once per finished task, and again after material fixes.

user_request.description: The user's original request and acceptance criteria, in their words where possible. Shares one size limit with work and evidence.

work.description: What you actually changed or produced: focused result or diff excerpts and the scope you claim. Shares one size limit with user_request and evidence.

evidence.description: Verification you observed: commands with their output, observations and known limitations. Paste output; a statement that tests passed is not evidence. Redact secrets first. Shares one size limit with user_request and work.

task_id.description: Stable identifier for the whole task. Reuse it across consult_mind and review_work so later calls include earlier exchanges.

review_id.description: New for each changed version of the work or evidence; reuse the same value only to retry an identical call.

phase.description: completion before reporting the task done; plan or progress only at a risky checkpoint.

media_evidence.description: Optional HTTPS links the user authorized to screenshots, audio or video of the result. Not with evidence files in one call. The reply's media_analysis says whether each link was analyzed, refused or failed.

evidence_ids.description: Ids from share_evidence whose files you uploaded; the consciousness reads their analysis. Not with media_evidence or learn.

learn.description: True only when the owner wants their mind to learn from this exchange. Needs the owner's learning permission; what it learns waits for the owner's review unless they auto-keep. Not with evidence files.

clone_id.description: Only when the owner approved several consciousnesses: the clone_id the owner chose.

tools.name: share_evidence
tools.description: Share a screenshot, recording or audio clip of the work privately with the owner's consciousness. Returns an evidence_id and an upload URL: upload the file's bytes with your shell, then pass evidence_ids to review_work or consult_mind. Analyzed for that task only, never kept as a memory.

clone_id.description: Only when the owner approved several consciousnesses: the clone_id the owner chose.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a note, decision or fact into the owner's consciousness, when the owner asks. It waits for their review unless they auto-keep. Needs the "save memories" permission.

clone_id.description: Only when the owner approved several consciousnesses: the clone_id the owner chose.

tools.name: list_pending_memories
tools.description: List memories waiting for the owner's review, so the owner can go through them with you. Needs the "review pending memories" permission.

clone_id.description: Only when the owner approved several consciousnesses: the clone_id the owner chose.

tools.name: review_pending_memory
tools.description: Approve, reject or rewrite one pending memory, only as the owner decides. Needs the "review pending memories" permission.

expected_content_revision.description: The content_revision list_pending_memories returned for this memory.

text.description: Only with decision update: the rewritten memory.

clone_id.description: Only when the owner approved several consciousnesses: the clone_id the owner chose.

tools.name: connection_status
tools.description: Show which Mind Upload account approval and consciousnesses this connection uses, its status, and how to disconnect or revoke it.

tools.name: disconnect
tools.description: End this Mind Upload connection and the owner approval behind it. Only when the owner asks to disconnect.
